name: Children's Museum of Indianapolis
tagline: One of America’s great children’s museums — huge; choose two wings max.

practical.ticket_note: Timed entry common — book ahead on childrensmuseum.org.
practical.best_start: Pick one physical wing + one make/play wing; schedule a snack.
